methodology.scope: The nine claims previously labeled score-bearing in ir-visual-coverage-gold-v1.
methodology.source_rule: Each decision uses only the rendered source PDF page and the issuer identity shown on that page. Prior classifier outputs and forward returns are excluded.

classes.A: The page contains an issuer-linked observable anchor that is genuinely score-bearing under the structural MOAT ontology.
classes.B: The page contains MOAT-relevant context, but no observable score-bearing anchor.
classes.C: The page lacks enough information to make a MOAT classification. Ordinary performance movement belongs here unless it directly erodes an allowed MOAT anchor.

observable_anchors.MARKET_SHARE: An issuer-specific numeric share, explicit leader/rank, or peer-relative share.
observable_anchors.CUSTOMER_RETENTION: Explicit renewal, repeat purchase/order by the same customer, retention/churn, contract renewal, or installed-base reuse/service dependence.
observable_anchors.MARGIN_STABILITY: Comparable margin or profitability persistence across at least three periods, or an explicit multi-period/consecutive profitability statement.
observable_anchors.COST_ADVANTAGE: A direct issuer-process comparison that links fewer steps, less time, lower cost, or higher yield to a named alternative.
observable_anchors.COUNTER: Observable deterioration or instability of an allowed MOAT anchor; ordinary revenue or profit decline alone is not enough.

non_score_bearing_components: One-year revenue and operating-profit changes by segment
claims.canonical_classifier_text: Redcap Tour reports that 2021 Q3 revenue fell 7% and operating profit fell 33% year over year, while rental-car profit fell 40% and the travel operating loss narrowed 51%.
claims.rationale: The page reports ordinary two-point performance changes. It does not show a persistent margin series or connect the decline to erosion of a MOAT mechanism or outcome.

non_score_bearing_components: Cumulative sputter orders increased from 2006 through 2023
Management describes a long trust relationship with a global display customer
claims.canonical_classifier_text: AVACO shows cumulative sputter orders rising about 74.9 times to KRW 674.6 billion and describes a long trust relationship with a global display customer.
claims.rationale: Cumulative orders and a customer-reference claim do not directly show renewal, repeat ordering by the same customer, retention, churn, or installed-base reuse.

claims.score_bearing_component: Eugene Technology's operating margin moved 24.7%, 12.1%, 30.5%, 11.8%, and 28.9% over five consecutive quarters.
non_score_bearing_components: Revenue and absolute profit levels without the cross-period profitability relation
claims.canonical_classifier_text: Eugene Technology's operating margin was 24.7%, 12.1%, 30.5%, 11.8%, and 28.9% from 2020 Q3 through 2021 Q3, showing large five-quarter volatility.
claims.rationale: The page directly shows multi-period margin instability, which is counterevidence to MARGIN_STABILITY rather than an ordinary one-period earnings decline.

claims.score_bearing_component: HK inno.N identifies K-CAB as the number-one product by market share in the peptic-ulcer drug market.
claims.canonical_classifier_text: HK inno.N states that its K-CAB product ranks number one by market share in the peptic-ulcer drug market; prescription and clinic-coverage figures are supporting context.
claims.rationale: The issuer-owned product and explicit category rank form a realized MARKET_SHARE outcome. Prescription growth alone would not.

claims.score_bearing_component: HK inno.N states that Condition continues to hold the number-one market share in hangover-relief products.
observable_anchors: Explicit issuer-product maintained number-one category share
claims.canonical_classifier_text: HK inno.N states that its Condition product continues to rank number one by market share in the hangover-relief category; convenience-store distribution is supporting context.
claims.rationale: The maintained number-one share is a realized MARKET_SHARE outcome. Distribution coverage alone is not a score-bearing share anchor.

claims.score_bearing_component: Global Tax Free is identified as the domestic number-one tax-refund operator with 70-75% market share.
claims.canonical_classifier_text: Global Tax Free is identified as the domestic number-one tax-refund operator with a 70-75% market share.
claims.rationale: The page directly links the issuer to both a numeric share and an explicit leader rank.

claims.score_bearing_component: EuBiologics states that Euvichol supplies more than 90% of the UNICEF public market.
observable_anchors: Issuer-product share above 90% in a named procurement market
claims.canonical_classifier_text: EuBiologics states that its Euvichol oral-cholera vaccine supplies more than 90% of the UNICEF public market; capacity, supply volume, and contract value are supporting context.
claims.rationale: Only the explicit UNICEF public-market share is score-bearing. A large supply contract or capacity figure alone is not MARKET_SHARE.

claims.score_bearing_component: EuBiologics directly produces EcML in E. coli, reducing production time and manufacturing cost versus GLA's 30-plus synthesis and purification steps.
observable_anchors: Direct comparison on process steps, production time, and manufacturing cost
claims.canonical_classifier_text: EuBiologics directly produces EcML in E. coli, reducing production time and manufacturing cost versus GLA, which requires more than 30 synthesis and purification steps and has high manufacturing cost.
claims.rationale: The page states a causal process-to-cost comparison against a named alternative, satisfying the COST_ADVANTAGE mechanism anchor.

claims.score_bearing_component: BIO-FD&C realized profits for eleven consecutive years.
claims.canonical_classifier_text: BIO-FD&C realized profits for eleven consecutive years from 2011 through 2023 and presents annual operating margins for the period; revenue CAGR is supporting context.
claims.rationale: The explicit long-run profitability persistence and annual margin series support MARGIN_STABILITY. Revenue growth alone does not.
